title: Best AI Ad Creative Analysis Tools & Creative Analytics Platforms (2026)
summary: Compare the 10 best ad creative analysis tools and software for 2026 by analysis depth, channel coverage, enterprise features, limitations, and pricing.
body_markdown:
The best ad creative analysis tools in 2026 are **[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/ad-creative-analysis-tool) for enterprise creative intelligence** , **Vidmob for predictive video analysis** , **Foreplay Lens for agencies** , and **Superads for lower-cost cross-channel reporting** .


This comparison covers software that **analyzes owned ad creative** , including hooks, visuals, messages, formats, audience signals, and fatigue.


## Best ad creative analytics platforms compared


Tool Best for What it analyzes Supported channels Starting price


**[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/ad-creative-analysis-tool)** **Enterprise ad creative analysis and end-to-end workflows** Hooks, messages, offers, CTAs, creators, scenes, product timing, audiences, fatigue, and competitor strategies Meta, Google, TikTok, and LinkedIn; more on higher plans $1,500/month for ad spend up to $100K / month


**Motion** **Visual creative analysis and reporting** Hooks, angles, personas, creators, formats, video drop-off, placements, demographics, and fatigue Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn $750/month

## 1.[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/ad-creative-analysis-tool) : Best AI ad creative analysis tool for enterprise teams


[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/) combines **element-level analysis, custom creative taxonomies, source-of-truth performance data, competitor intelligence** , recommendations, and enterprise workflows.


Teams can analyze hooks, messages, offers, creators, scenes, product timing, CTAs, audiences, formats, and fatigue across video and static ads. **Each business can define its own labels, metrics, winner criteria, and attribution windows.**


- **Performance-data integration:** Connects creative attributes with ad-platform data, custom KPIs, MMPs, attribution platforms, BI systems, warehouses, and first-party data.
- **Competitive intelligence:** Identifies competitor angles, concepts, launch cadence, active days, geographic availability, and gaps in the advertiser's strategy.
- **Actionability:** Explains performance differences, supports follow-up questions, prioritizes findings, and turns approved insights into briefs, concepts, or assets.
- **Enterprise fit:** Higher plans add automated workflows, Slack, Figma, DAM and API integrations, SSO, admin roles, on-premise deployment, and private-model options.
- **Channel coverage:** Supports[Meta ad creative analysis](https://getcrux.ai/discover/ai-meta-ad-creative-analysis-tools) ,[TikTok ad creative analysis](https://getcrux.ai/discover/best-tiktok-ad-creative-analysis-tools) , Google, and LinkedIn.


**Limitation:**[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/discover/ad-creative-analysis-tool) is built for teams with substantial creative volume. Smaller advertisers may find it an overkill.


**Pricing:** Starter plan is **$1,500 per month** . Professional and Enterprise pricing is custom.


In the Jerry case study, a process involving three months of Meta ads and a seven-part spreadsheet was **reduced to a prompt, follow-up questions, and custom breakdowns** based on Jerry's testing framework.


Explore[GetCrux](https://getcrux.ai/)


## 2. Motion: best for visual creative reporting


**Motion presents ad assets beside their performance data in visual reports** designed for strategists, media buyers, and creative teams. Its analysis covers hooks, angles, personas, creators, formats, video drop-off, placements, demographics, and fatigue.


- **Standout capability:** Custom groupings and visual reports make creative findings easy to review and share across teams.
- **Limitation:** Publicly documented external performance integrations are **mainly Northbeam and Google Analytics, both on Pro** .
- **Pricing:** Starter costs **$750 per month** . Pro costs **$1,200 per month** , while Growth pricing is custom.


HexClad reported **saving more than ten hours per week** after replacing naming conventions and spreadsheet-based reporting with Motion.


## 3. Hawky: best for element-level diagnosis


**Hawky scores individual creative elements and connects them with performance evidence.** It analyzes hooks, opening frames, visuals, claims, CTAs, voiceovers, on-screen text, audio, audience signals, and fatigue.


- **Standout capability:** Cited Copilot answers help teams identify which element to retain, replace, or test in the next iteration.
- **Limitation:** The Creative Agent **currently generates static ads** . Video generation is planned, while custom integrations and autonomous agents require the highest tier.
- **Pricing:** **Custom pricing** based on brands, creative volume, and usage.


The Man Company reported **cutting creative iteration time by 50%** after using Hawky to identify winning and fatiguing elements.


### 4. Atria: best for Meta and TikTok competitor research


**Atria combines owned-ad analysis with competitor research for Meta and TikTok.** Its Radar feature monitors creative performance and recommends which ads or elements should be scaled, revised, or replaced.


- **Standout capability:** Radar connects hooks, personas, USPs, creators, scenes, audio, and text with competitor patterns and proposed iterations.
- **Limitation:** Connected-account analysis is **concentrated on Meta and TikTok** . Custom metrics require the Business plan.
- **Pricing:** Core starts at **$129 per month** when billed annually. Plus costs $479, Business costs $959, and Enterprise pricing is custom.


Rubix reported **reducing creative-analysis and turnaround time by 40%** after adopting Atria.


## 5. Foreplay Lens: best for agencies


**Foreplay Lens analyzes owned Meta and TikTok ads and converts the findings into visual, client-ready reports.** Its metadata covers personas, hooks, themes, creators, influencers, transcripts, custom tags, trends, and creative test groups.


- **Standout capability:** Lens combines owned-ad analysis with Foreplay's Spyder competitor tracker, briefing tools, benchmarks, and white-label report sharing.
- **Limitation:** The Workflow plan includes Lens for **one brand** . Additional brands cost **$50 each** , while wider agency coverage requires a higher plan.
- **Pricing:** Workflow costs **$175 per month** . Agency includes ten Lens brands, and Enterprise pricing is custom.


Growth Collective reports using Lens to build **client reports in minutes instead of hours** .


## 6. Superads: best lower-cost cross-channel option


**Superads provides visual creative reporting across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Google Ads.** It uses AI and custom tags to group ads by hook, format, product, creator, messaging angle, emotion, headline, CTA, and other creative variables.


- **Standout capability:** Teams can compare creative patterns across several channels and accounts through interactive reports, with unlimited users and workspaces.
- **Limitation:** **Google Ads remains marked as beta** in Superads documentation. **Pricing rises with connected ad spend.**
- **Pricing:** Professional costs **$150 per month** , or **$125 per month when billed annually** , for up to $100,000 in monthly ad spend.


Oneflow used Superads to **combine Meta and LinkedIn data and compare creative themes** without repeated platform exports.


## 7. Vidmob: best for predictive video analysis


Vidmob uses computer vision to **identify objects, people, scenes, activities, branding, color, contrast, gaze, emotion, recognized talent, and element timing** within images and video.


- **Standout capability:** Vidmob has the strongest published predictive-validity evidence in this comparison, together with detailed frame-level analysis.
- **Limitation:** **Carousel ads are unsupported in Creative Analytics** , and some multi-creative formats return incomplete data. Standard processing covers paid-media assets **under two minutes** unless otherwise agreed.
- **Pricing:** **Custom pricing** based on annual impressions per brand.


In a study with Kroger and MMA Global, Vidmob analyzed 1,934 assets and achieved **81% accuracy** when predicting later ecommerce creative performance across Meta and DV360.


## 8. GoMarble: best for analysis connected to paid-media action


GoMarble analyzes selected images and videos, answers questions about their performance, and **carries findings into briefs, monitoring tasks, or proposed account changes** .


Its coverage includes visual and audio hooks, text, voiceovers, personas, emotions, proof, offers, CTAs, landing pages, and fatigue.


- **Standout capability:** Agents can run recurring analysis, evaluate untested assets before launch, and move approved recommendations into campaign operations.
- **Limitation:** Plans include **ad-spend, account, seat, and AI-credit limits** . Copilot supports one user, and **unused credits do not roll over** .
- **Pricing:** Copilot starts at **$139 per month** . Operator costs **$399** , Scale costs **$799** , and Enterprise pricing is custom.


Kaizen reported an approximately **eightfold improvement in reporting turnaround** after adopting GoMarble.


## 9. Marpipe: best for controlled catalog creative testing


**Marpipe creates feed-driven catalog ad variants, runs them as live ads, and compares treatments across products.** Teams can test product images, layouts, pricing displays, offers, social proof, backgrounds, and other feed variables.


- **Standout capability:** Conditional rules let ecommerce teams test and apply different designs across hundreds or thousands of SKUs.
- **Limitation:** Marpipe is **specialized catalog testing software** , not a broad semantic analysis platform for existing UGC, conventional video, or non-catalog ads. Findings require **live tests and media spend** .
- **Pricing:** **A free plan** supports design exploration. Startup costs **$199 per month** , while Enterprise starts at **$999** plus SKU-based pricing.


Taylor Stitch reported **increasing creative testing output tenfold** and running two tests per week with more than 80 variants each.


## 10. Singular Creative IQ: best for mobile creative analysis


**Singular Creative IQ combines creative assets with mobile cost and attribution data.** It provides 17 built-in AI tags and clusters identical or near-identical assets across networks, campaign structures, and file names.


- **Standout capability:** Creative analysis is directly connected with Singular's mobile attribution and cost data, making it suited to app and gaming acquisition teams.
- **Limitation:** Creative IQ is **primarily designed for mobile user acquisition** . Asset previews and available dimensions depend on the data exposed by each network.
- **Pricing:** Basic creative reporting is included with Singular's **free attribution plan** . **Creative IQ pricing is custom** , with a 14-day trial available.


East Side Games reported reducing reports that previously took **one to two hours per game to seconds** and applying creative learnings twice as quickly.
